atoms.normalized_claim: The Field Register uses the TRAVEL verb, is available in Away, and functions to carry a party through extended territory, route choices, time, weather, drag, and load.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Crossing     | RISK     | Away             | Resolve immediate lane-scale panic, commitment, traffic windows, and bodily hazard.     |
atoms.normalized_claim: The Crossing Register uses the RISK verb, is available in Away, and functions to resolve immediate lane-scale panic, commitment, traffic windows, and bodily hazard.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Encounter    | MEET     | Home and Away    | Stage a bounded consequential circumstance and ask what the Colony or party will do.    |
atoms.normalized_claim: The Encounter Register uses the MEET verb, is available in both Home and Away, and functions to stage a bounded consequential circumstance asking what the Colony or party will do.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Colony       | DWELL    | Home             | Creates the need, loses the departing shares, and receives the return.                  |
atoms.normalized_claim: The Colony Register uses the DWELL verb, is available in Home, and functions to create the need, lose the departing shares, and receive the return.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Embodiment   | EMBODY   | Home only        | Becomes available only after return and restored Quiet Equilibrium.                     |
atoms.normalized_claim: The Embodiment Register uses the EMBODY verb, is available Home only, and becomes available only after return and restored Quiet Equilibrium.

atoms.exact_source_text: Mode is defined by the crunch subject, not by geography or camera.
atoms.normalized_claim: Mode is determined by the crunch subject, not by geography or camera.

atoms.exact_source_text: Launch is the outward threshold: once the party commits, particular Citizens become the resolved subject and the game is Away—even while they still traverse the Home Reach toward the road edge.
atoms.normalized_claim: Launch is the outward threshold at which the game becomes Away once the party commits, even while traversing the Home Reach toward the road edge.

atoms.exact_source_text: Homecoming is the inward threshold: the game becomes Home only when the Colony has received the returning party and recalculated its civic posture.
atoms.normalized_claim: Homecoming is the inward threshold at which the game becomes Home only once the Colony has received the returning party and recalculated its civic posture.

atoms.exact_source_text: Before Launch: “How much Colony capacity is committed?”
atoms.normalized_claim: Before Launch, the mode test question is how much Colony capacity is committed.

atoms.exact_source_text: After Launch: “Which particular Citizens are carrying this?”
atoms.normalized_claim: After Launch, the mode test question is which particular Citizens are carrying this.

atoms.exact_source_text: After Homecoming: “What can the Colony now sustain, repair, remember, and permit?”
atoms.normalized_claim: After Homecoming, the mode test question is what the Colony can now sustain, repair, remember, and permit.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Register is a mode of attention.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Register is defined as a mode of attention.

atoms.exact_source_text: A View is a particular presentation within it.
atoms.normalized_claim: A View is defined as a particular presentation within a Register.

atoms.exact_source_text: Launch and Homecoming are connector Views using MEET’s fixed, consequential attention without becoming separate Registers.
atoms.normalized_claim: Launch and Homecoming are connector Views that use MEET's fixed, consequential attention without becoming separate Registers.

atoms.exact_source_text: Staging, Stopover, and Chronicle are also Views or layers, not new modes.
atoms.normalized_claim: Staging, Stopover, and Chronicle are Views or layers rather than new modes.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Citizens leave because they belong.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Citizens leave on expeditions because they belong to the Colony.

atoms.exact_source_text: Expeditions are a commitment to sustain, grow, reconnect, or understand the Colony—not a detached hero career.
atoms.normalized_claim: Expeditions represent a commitment to sustain, grow, reconnect, or understand the Colony, not a detached hero career.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Launch is subtraction.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Launch is characterized as subtraction.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony visibly loses the exact named shares, occupancy, and availability that depart.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Colony visibly loses the exact named shares, occupancy, and availability that depart on Launch.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Away is individually resolved.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Away is individually resolved.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species capability, equipment, wounds, fear memories, relationships, route knowledge, Distinctions, and personal history matter here.
atoms.normalized_claim: In Away, species capability, equipment, wounds, fear memories, relationships, route knowledge, Distinctions, and personal history matter.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Facts belong to world state.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Facts belong to world state.

atoms.exact_source_text: One injury, one cargo object, one relationship, one route, one clock, and one record are exposed differently by each Register; no parallel versions are created.
atoms.normalized_claim: A single injury, cargo object, relationship, route, clock, and record are each exposed differently by each Register, with no parallel versions created.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Nodes are the meal; cards are the weather.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Nodes are described as the meal while cards are described as the weather.

atoms.exact_source_text: Field traversal is not a stream of event popups.
atoms.normalized_claim: Field traversal is not a stream of event popups.

atoms.exact_source_text: Most consequence is anchored to places the player chooses to enter.
atoms.normalized_claim: Most consequence is anchored to places the player chooses to enter.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Crossing is brief because it is terrible.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Crossing is brief because it is terrible.

atoms.exact_source_text: RISK must remain concentrated, committed, and legible
atoms.normalized_claim: RISK must remain concentrated, committed, and legible.
